mapper.select:
SELECT a.FINPROD_ID AS finprodId, b.FINPROD_ABBR AS finprodAbbr, a.INPUT_TYPE AS valueSource, a.VAL_DATE AS valueDate, a.VALUATION AS valueAsset FROM FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION a left JOIN FIN_PRODUCT b ON a.FINPROD_ID = b.FINPROD_ID and a.FINPROD_TYPE = b.FINPROD_TYPE WHERE 1=1 and b.PROFIT_TYPE in ('01','03') and a.FINPROD_TYPE='F17'
AND a.FINPROD_ID in
#{item}
AND b.FINPROD_ABBR like concat_ws('','%',#{finprodAbbr},'%')
AND a.VAL_DATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{valueDateBegin},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND a.VAL_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{valueDateEnd},'%Y-%m-%d')
mapper.delete: delete from FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION where FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and VAL_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{valueDate} ,'%Y-%m-%d') and FINPROD_TYPE= 'F17'
